name: Skip room-add duplicate check
description: Every time any unit is added to a room (missile creation, room crossing, spawns), the engine walked the room's whole unit list only to assert that the unit was not already in it. The check feeds a debug assert and changes nothing in game, but with many missiles in a room it costs a full list walk per add. This jumps over the walk straight to the list insertion. Independent of the room-unit-index plugin; the two together remove all three full list walks.

patches.description: UNITROOM_AddUnitToRoomEx: short jump from the duplicate-check setup (0x38ED8B) to the insertion at 0x38EDC9. Nothing after the loop reads the registers it used.
